baselines.ACTION_MEDIAN: per-action median effect; existing global-action-style boring baseline
baselines.ACTION_PLUS_SHARED_SLOPE: per-action intercept plus one shared scalar slope; five-parameter boring ordered model
baselines.ACTION_SPECIFIC_AFFINE: independent affine effect model per action; eight-parameter richer boring comparator
baselines.STATE_ONLY_AFFINE: single affine effect model over ordered current scalar; intentionally removes action identity
